title: "I think you broke somthing"
description: Adds "The Missing Texture" as a block to prank your friends and for use in map making
body:
This mod adds one simple thing, The Null Block, a simple block that uses the missing texture.
Use this to make maps or to troll your friends, this block also glows in the dark without emitting any light similar to the glow squid. This block can be crafted by putting an Amethyst or Blackstone block in a stonecutter.
